preferences.name: hiddenApps
preferences.title: Hidden Applications
preferences.description: IDs of applications that are not shown in search

name: Calculator
description: Evaluate math expressions right in the search bar

name: Clipboard History
description: Search and paste everything you copied.

preferences.name: maxItems
preferences.title: Maximum items
preferences.description: Older unpinned items are removed. 0 keeps everything.

preferences.name: maxDays
preferences.title: Keep items for (days)
preferences.description: Unpinned items not used for this many days are removed. 0 keeps them forever.

preferences.name: recordImages
preferences.title: Record images
preferences.description: Save copied images in the history.

preferences.name: ignoreApps
preferences.title: Ignored applications
preferences.description: Executable names whose copies are never recorded, e.g. KeePassXC.exe.

name: File Search (Everything)
description: Find files and folders on this computer instantly with voidtools Everything.

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Maximum results
preferences.description: Number of files shown for a search (at most 1000).

preferences.name: matchPath
preferences.title: Match full path
preferences.description: Match the search text against the whole path, not just the name.

preferences.name: showInRoot
preferences.title: Show files in the main search
preferences.description: List up to 5 matching files below apps and commands for searches of 3 or more characters.

preferences.name: hideSystemFiles
preferences.title: Hide system files
preferences.description: Leave out files in Windows, program data, caches and package folders (node_modules, site-packages, …). When off they are listed after your own files.

preferences.name: extraLowPriorityPaths
preferences.title: Low-priority locations
preferences.description: Folders listed after your own files, like system files: a full path (D:\VMs) or a folder name matched anywhere (vendor, build).
